description: Administrators only: every company on the installation — its plan, what state it is in (trial, active, over-limit, suspended…), when what it paid for runs out, how many days are left, what it is using against what it may use, and its balance. Ask with endingInDays to get only the ones running out that soon, which is how 'whose trial ends this week' is answered in one call. 'attention' is the console's own short list of rows somebody has to look at. A meter reading null means the machine holding that company was not asked, not that it is idle. Owners are left out unless withOwners is true, and an e-mail address is never returned.

endingInDays.description: Only companies whose paid-for period ends within this many days. 0 means already run out.

slug.description: Only the company at this address ('acme' in acme.kaiku.tech).

withOwners.description: Include who owns each company — username and display name, never an e-mail. Off by default: this is a statistics surface, and a list of customers with names on it is a customer list.

name: admin_workspaces
